title: Jaffna University students and community members protest Mullivaikkal memorial demolition
location: Outside the University of Jaffna gates and on the campus, Jaffna; the report describes an initial sit-in inside before protesters moved outside.
organizer: University students and community members; formal organizing body unspecified
participants_original: Tamil Guardian described “dozens” outside the university on 8–9 January; Ada Derana later describes students, residents and political representatives gathering but gives no number.
threshold_50_evidence: Contemporary Tamil Guardian reports call the crowd “dozens.” Ada Derana identifies students, residents and political representatives without a count. No source establishes a lower bound of 50.

start_date.summary: The Sunday Times dated 11 January describes the gathering as beginning on Friday night, consistent with 8 January; the 8/9 January contemporary reports provide the date context.

end_date.summary: Reports describe the crowd remaining until the morning after 8 January, many dispersing after a police warning, and the student fast ending on 11 January after a reconstruction promise. None establishes the physical end of the wider protest sequence.

participants_original.summary: News 1st and The Sunday Times name alumni, students, the public and residents but supply no count; Daily Mirror supplies no number for the fast.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The Sunday Times and News 1st identify participants, and Peoples Dispatch uses qualitative scale language, but no report provides a lower bound establishing 50 at this gathering.

demands.summary: The Sunday Times reports that students and the public demanded authorities stop the demolition; News 1st reports efforts to meet the vice-chancellor; Daily Mirror and Peoples Dispatch report the reconstruction demand.

state_response.accommodation.summary: The Sunday Times and Daily Mirror report a 11 January vice-chancellor meeting and reconstruction assurance/foundation ceremony; Peoples Dispatch also reports the agreement.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: News 1st says police warned the overnight group it would be subjected to PCR testing if the gathering continued and many dispersed after the announcement; this is an attributed attempted dispersal.

episode_key.summary: The 8 January campus protest and student fast form the Jaffna sequence in contemporary reports. A separate multi-day Pottuvil–Polikandy march began on 3 February and involved a distinct route and civil-society campaign; no opened source connects it to continued physical assembly at the university.

notes: The campus demonstration continued overnight into 9 January, while a hunger strike by five students began on 9 January and ended after the 11 January rebuilding promise; the fast is part of the same Jaffna protest sequence in these reports, not separately counted. A region-wide hartal also occurred on 11 January, but sources describe shutdowns and curtailed services rather than a separately documented public assembly. News 1st also reports a police PCR-testing warning followed by dispersal of many people on the morning after the overnight gathering; Daily Mirror separately reports the fast ending after a 11 January vice-chancellor meeting and Batticaloa-area closures, without a separate assembly count. The 11 January Sunday Times report confirms the vice-chancellor meeting and notes regional hartal closures; Peoples Dispatch describes broad protest activity but supplies no Jaffna headcount. A separate Pottuvil–Polikandy march began on 3 February, according to a later Tamil Guardian report; its distinct route and organizers do not establish that the Jaffna campus gathering continued into February.
open_questions: Was the crowd at least 50 people at any point?
When did the assembly physically end after 2:30 a.m.?
Which authority made the reported rebuilding promise and when?
Was the later North-East hartal a distinct assembly or part of a continuous protest episode?
Was there a separate gathering in Batticaloa during the 11 January closures?
